summary: Raiding cavalry civ with defensive bonuses. Grasslands spawn horses for instant, cheaper cavalry, up to 20 Mounted Villagers gather fast, and Emissaries set up Tributaries or bribe enemy soldiers.
openings: Landmark choices include Great Pasture, Flower Pagoda, Mountain Hall, Dragon Pavilion, Pagoda Forest and Great Wall Bastion.

spikes.label: Grassland cavalry
spikes.detail: Grasslands spawn horses faster in Feudal this patch, so cavalry comes out of War Stables quickly.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and towers near your resources.

spikes.label: Iron Pagoda
spikes.detail: Iron Pagoda heavy cavalry and Nest of Bees join in Castle.
spikes.answer: Mass spearmen, and cavalry to catch the siege.

scout: Mounted Villagers moving to new resources

pairings.why: Feudal siege against buildings and cavalry.

howToBeat: Keep spearmen and towers at every resource line.
Stay grouped so Emissaries can't pick off units.
